name: pinecone
description: Manage Pinecone vector database indexes and query or upsert vectors

tools.name: List Indexes
tools.description: List all indexes in the Pinecone project

historicalSummary.omitted: index spec details and provider-specific payload fields

tools.name: Describe Index
tools.description: Get an index's configuration and its data-plane host. Drop the trailing '.pinecone.io' from the returned host to get the indexHostPrefix that Query Vectors and Upsert Vectors take.

tools.name: Create Index
tools.description: Create a new serverless or pod-based index

name.description: Index name (1-45 characters, lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens)

dimension.description: Vector dimension (required for dense indexes), e.g. 1536

metric.description: Distance metric: cosine, euclidean, or dotproduct

tools.name: Query Vectors
tools.description: Query a Pinecone index for the nearest vectors. Select the index with indexHostPrefix (its data-plane host from Describe Index without the trailing '.pinecone.io').

indexHostPrefix.description: Index data-plane host without the trailing '.pinecone.io': for a Describe Index host of 'my-index-abc1234.svc.aped-4627-b74a.pinecone.io' pass 'my-index-abc1234.svc.aped-4627-b74a'. Requests can only reach '<indexHostPrefix>.pinecone.io', so each call may target a different index while credentials stay confined to Pinecone-owned hosts.

vector.description: Query vector values (must match the index dimension)

topK.description: Number of nearest matches to return

namespace.description: Namespace to query (omit for the default namespace)

includeMetadata.description: Include record metadata in the matches

includeValues.description: Include vector values in the matches

tools.name: Upsert Vectors
tools.description: Write vectors into a Pinecone index selected via indexHostPrefix — verify the prefix names the intended index before writing

indexHostPrefix.description: Index data-plane host without the trailing '.pinecone.io': for a Describe Index host of 'my-index-abc1234.svc.aped-4627-b74a.pinecone.io' pass 'my-index-abc1234.svc.aped-4627-b74a'. Requests can only reach '<indexHostPrefix>.pinecone.io', so each call may target a different index while credentials stay confined to Pinecone-owned hosts.

namespace.description: Namespace to write into (omit for the default namespace)

prompts.title: List my indexes
prompts.prompt: List my Pinecone indexes with their dimensions, metrics, and status.

prompts.title: Search an index
prompts.prompt: Describe my Pinecone index to get its data-plane host, then query it (using the host without the trailing '.pinecone.io' as indexHostPrefix) with an embedding vector and show the top matches with metadata.

SETUP_GUIDE.title: Pinecone API Setup

steps.title: Create a Pinecone account
steps.description: Sign up at https://app.pinecone.io — the free Starter plan includes serverless indexes for testing.

steps.title: Create an API key
steps.description: In the Pinecone console, select your project, open API Keys, and create a key (pcsk_...). Copy it immediately.

steps.title: Store the key
steps.description: Add it to your .env file as PINECONE_API_KEY=pcsk_...

steps.title: Verify access
steps.description: Run the List Indexes tool. To read or write vectors, first run Describe Index for the index you want, take the returned 'host' value, and pass it without the trailing '.pinecone.io' as the indexHostPrefix parameter of Query Vectors / Upsert Vectors.

notes: Pinecone is two-step: control-plane tools (list/describe/create index) hit api.pinecone.io, while Query Vectors and Upsert Vectors target the index named by their indexHostPrefix parameter — each call may address a different index, and requests can only reach '<indexHostPrefix>.pinecone.io' hosts, never an arbitrary domain

Migrating from earlier versions: the old indexHost parameter (full host) and the interim PINECONE_INDEX_HOST environment variable are gone — pass the Describe Index host without its '.pinecone.io' suffix as indexHostPrefix instead
All requests send the X-Pinecone-API-Version header (default 2025-01)
Embeddings must be generated separately (e.g. with OpenAI) — vectors you query or upsert must match the index dimension
